chunks: Then he said: O sons of 'Abd al-Muttalib,
certainly I do not wish to see you plunging harshly into the blood of Muslims shouting, 'Amir al-Mu'minin has been killed.'
Beware, do not kill on account of me except my killer.

key_terms.خَوْضاً: Plunging / mixing deeply (metaphor for engaging in bloodshed)

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say to Banu Abd al-Muttalib regarding his death and the reaction of the Muslims?
ai.summary: This directive to Banu Abd al-Muttalib serves as a strategic restraint against impulsive vengeance, ensuring that the Prophet's death does not immediately trigger a chaotic civil war among the Quraysh. The phrase 'I will not be killed except by my killer' is interpreted by Shia scholars as a divine preordination of his martyrdom, distinguishing his death from a mere battlefield casualty to a destined sacrifice.

en.sayed-ali-raza: Then he said: O’ sons of ‘Abd al-Muṭṭalib,
certainly I do not wish to see you plunging harshly into the blood of Muslims shouting “Amīr al-mu’minīn has been killed.”
Beware, do not kill on account of me except my killer.
